title: Childhood sighting of a wobbling reddish-orange light
summary: Gary McKinnon tells of Childhood sighting of a wobbling reddish-orange light, about c. 1976 (age about 12) at McKinnon's bedroom window, UK, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and uh I had one sighting myself uh when I was about 12 and um I was looking out of my bedroom window and I saw this kind of reddish orange glowing light and it was moving in an arc from there to the horizon

plain: Gary McKinnon, a British computer hacker who says he searched US government computers for hidden evidence of UFOs, told podcast host Jesse Michels about a sighting of his own around 1976. He says that at about age 12, looking out of his bedroom window, he saw a wobbling, glowing reddish-orange light move in an arc down to the horizon.
